description: The brand's Klaviyo LISTS with how many profiles each holds (profile count), single or double opt-in, and when each was created and updated, newest first. Klaviyo pages lists 10 at a time: pass nextCursor for more, or name for one exact list. A list id is a campaign audience (create_klaviyo_campaign listIds) or a lead-sync target. Read-only, free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: list_klaviyo_lists
title: List Klaviyo lists
